note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for parts + defect taxonomy. Every module (annotate_aes2, teach_cups, build_pt, run_pt) reads names / severity / colors from here via taxonomy.py. To add or rename a defect, edit ONLY this file, then run: python qms.py build.

Cut / Chip.description: A bite of material missing from a rolled edge - the outline steps inward or looks torn/faceted instead of a smooth continuous curve.

Dent.description: A localised inward deformation of the rim or flange face that does not remove material.

Deformation.description: Central bore is not a clean circle - one side pinched, dented inward or ovalised (out-of-round).

Notch.description: A small raised nub, square tab, or bite/indentation breaking the smooth curve of an edge or the inner collar rim.

Rust.description: Brown/orange mottled corrosion or discoloration on the drawn wall or face.

Stain.description: Discrete dark/black smudge or burn on the metal face; darker than surrounding metal and NOT a shadow.

Reject Paint Mark.description: Deliberate red/pink inspection paint marking where an operator flagged a problem. Secondary marker - hunt the adjacent real defect.

OK.description: Smooth continuous outer flange, unbroken inner rim curve, round bore, no discrete dark mark, no missing material.
